title: Perturbation stress test of a data-driven dekadal streamflow model in nine Central Asian mountain basins
description: Code accompanying Nasridinov (2026), 'Can tree-based streamflow models respond to climate change they never saw? A perturbation stress test in nine Central Asian mountain basins', submitted to Journal of Water and Climate Change. Applies delta-change perturbations of temperature and precipitation to a gradient-boosted dekadal streamflow ensemble without retraining, and compares its response against an uncalibrated degree-day water balance forced identically.
